name: Phenylephrine
summary: Phenylephrine, sold under the brand names Neosynephrine and Sudafed PE among others, is a medication used as a decongestant for uncomplicated nasal congestion in the form of a nasal spray or oral tablet, intravenously in cases of low blood pressure, or as a suppository to relieve hemorrhoids. It can also be applied to the skin.

pharmacology.text: Phenylephrine is a selective agonist of the α1-adrenergic receptor, one of the biological targets of the catecholamine hormones and neurotransmitters epinephrine (adrenaline) and norepinephrine (noradrenaline). It is a full agonist of the α1-adrenergic receptor in most assessed tissues. The drug has weak, minimal, or no agonist activity at the α2-adrenergic receptor or the β-adrenergic receptors. At the β-adrenergic receptors, it is a partial agonist.

uses.text: Phenylephrine, sold under the brand names Neosynephrine and Sudafed PE among others, is a medication used as a decongestant for uncomplicated nasal congestion in the form of a nasal spray or oral tablet, intravenously in cases of low blood pressure, or as a suppository to relieve hemorrhoids. Common side effects when taken by mouth or injected include nausea, vomiting, headache, and anxiety.
uses.routes: Oral, intranasal, ophthalmic, intravenous, intramuscular, rectal

sideEffects.text: Common side effects when taken by mouth or injected include nausea, vomiting, headache, and anxiety. Severe side effects may include a slow heart rate, intestinal ischemia, chest pain, kidney failure, and tissue death at the site of injection.

summaryZh: 苯福林是一種用作藥品的N-甲基苯乙胺衍生物。可以作為鼻腔減充血劑，以鼻腔噴霧劑或口服片劑的形式治療單純性鼻塞；可以用於散瞳，在低血壓情況下通過靜脈注射提高血壓，以及以栓劑形式緩解痔瘡。它也可以經皮給藥。
summaryZhHans: 苯福林是一种用作药品的N-甲基苯乙胺衍生物。可以作为鼻腔减充血剂，以鼻腔喷雾剂或口服片剂的形式治疗单纯性鼻塞；可以用于散瞳，在低血压情况下通过静脉注射提高血压，以及以栓剂形式缓解痔疮。它也可以经皮给药。
